ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low; approximately 15-20% high-intensity white/grey pixels relative to 80-85% low-intensity dark pixels on the visible ventral surface of the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Irregular white and light-grey mottling concentrated on the distal 25% and along the leading edge of the left lobe; a large, contiguous dark-pixel mass dominates the central and proximal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute V-shaped indentation dividing the lobes; the vertex is sharply defined despite minor water occlusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and irregular-amplitude serrations present across the entire boundary; the right lobe exhibits significantly larger, jagged peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a convex curve toward the distal tip; the right lobe displays a broader, more pronounced convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, textured brownish-white pixel clusters (colonization) localized along the trailing edges and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness/tearing across the trailing edge topography and significant textured accretion on the fluke margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical serration pattern between the left and right lobe trailing edges.
